_comment: Beyond-W3C fixture for docs/fstar-extracted/index.html. Phase 1 (#242) populates this with all 33 queries by extracting from the HTML; this seed entry exists so Phase 2a (#243) has a concrete failing query to land its runner against. The bind-upper query is the canonical #240 reproducer.

queries.name: bind-upper
queries.label: BIND + string functions

expected._note: Actual row count from native run on docs/fstar-extracted/samples/people.ttl.

queries._status: fixed in #240; runners should now match native across native/js-node/wasm-node

expected._note: All 8 people; the query exists to surface the value-level UCASE/LCASE wrongness, not row-count.

expected_to_fail.note: FStar_String.{upper,lower}case is BatString.{upper,lower}case_ascii — non-ASCII letters pass through unchanged. 'Eve Müller' uppercases to 'EVE MüLLER' instead of 'EVE MÜLLER'. Affects native + js-node + wasm-node equally; not a runtime asymmetry. When this turns green the expected_to_fail marker should be removed and a value-equivalence check added.
